The work
"A garment
for life.
Not a season."

Giulia Christen does not design collections. She makes pieces — one at a time, for one person, to last a lifetime. The leather is chosen by hand. The pattern is drawn by hand. Every stitch is placed with care and intention.

This is not a brand. It is a practice — shaped over thirty years in Zürich, Milan, Paris and Hamburg, where leather and silver became her language and her silence.

Her story
Not fashion.
Not a collection.
A single piece, made for you.

The designer

A life
shaped by leather.

Giulia Christen is not a brand. She is a craftsperson — a woman who has devoted her life to leather, to scissors, to the silent language of a perfectly cut hide.

After the Kunstschule Zürich and Fashion Design at NABA Milan, she trained as assistant designer at Guy Laroche in Paris. Then Hamburg called — and leather found her.

She mastered the craft of leather and silver, and built a clientele that included some of the most iconic names in rock history. Today she works from Zürich, with her Hamburg atelier still very much alive.

Everything by hand. Everything once.

Written about her

Die Ledermacherin.

Avery Manufattura Magazin · Zürich
"Ein Kleidungsstück fürs Leben geschneidert."

An der Fortunagasse in Zürich befindet sich das Atelier eines Schatzsuchers. Schätze aus Leder und Silber, handgemacht. Jede Jacke ein Einzelstück. Die Besitzerin, Giulia Christen, passt perfekt zum Inventar: elegant, dunkel, die wilden schwarzen Locken.

Opium Hamburg · 2024
"Das Pyratenschiff — Giulia Christen übernimmt."

Als Fritz Ahrens nach 40 Jahren Pyrate Style verliess, blieb Giulia Christen — und steuerte das Schiff weiter. Der unverwechselbare Stil, die gnadenlose Qualität. Ihr Kundenkreis: Keith Richards, Lionel Richie, Lenny Kravitz.

pyratestyle.com · Hamburg
"100% Handarbeit. Jedes Stück ein Unikat."

Von der Lederauswahl über das persönliche Schnittmuster bis zur Umsetzung — jeder Schritt für die vollständige Zufriedenheit des Kunden. Giulia Christen: 100% Massanfertigung.
